svg.title: High-frequency trading engine: Sub-millisecond architecture
svg.desc: Real-time market data ingestion from multiple brokers through Kafka to low-latency trading engine on AWS

g.text: Topics: price_updates, trades, order_books | Partitions by symbol | Retention: 24h
Consume Kafka stream • Match price updates to open positions
Compute real-time P&L (entry price vs current price × quantity)
Execute trading logic: stop-loss, take-profit, rebalancing (sub-ms latency)
API Gateway → Lambda functions → Step Functions state machine
Circuit breaker pattern: if broker unreachable, route to fallback broker
Redis: in-memory order book + position cache (ms access time)
RDS: persistent order history, trade logs, audit trail (compliance)
